summary: Independent review of all eight Android TV fix files found no actionable defects. Verified playback checkpoint readiness, final-save ordering, continuation and Home refresh, navigation cancellation, and recovery after visiting Profiles. The first review found a P2 Profiles-return gap; it was fixed and covered before this fresh review. Validation: 45 JVM tests passed, debug and instrumentation APK builds passed, lint had 0 errors and 21 existing warnings, Go build/full PostgreSQL and media test suite passed, and the web audit passed. Native instrumentation still requires a TV/emulator; final progress writes remain best-effort on network failure.
